Turning the parquet files into GeoTIFF with two bands: 1 for NDMI and 2 for NDVI. 
One GeoTIFF per month per year for oct 2025 to sep 2026
One GeoTIFF per month for all 5 years containing mean NDMI and NDVI per grid cell
One GeoTIFF per month containing 
- mean NDMI and NDVI per grid cell 
- assigned precipitation 
- air temperature
KIV:
- land use:
    - park: 0/1
    - reserve: 0/1
Mask out water bodies 

Load the required libraries:
```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(duckdb)
library(terra)
library(DBI)
```

# Step 1: Load parquet files and save as GeoTIFF

Setting up duckDB connection

```{r}
duck_con <- dbConnect(duckdb())

dbExecute(duck_con, "SET memory_limit = '8GB'")
dbExecute(duck_con, "SET threads = 2")
dbExecute(duck_con, "SET preserve_insertion_order = false")

dir.create(
  here("data", "duckdb_temp"),
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

temp_path <- normalizePath(
  here("data", "duckdb_temp")
)

dbExecute(
  duck_con,
  paste0(
    "SET temp_directory = '",
    temp_path,
    "'"
  )
)
```
Lazy-loading parquet files
```{r}
dbExecute(
  duck_con,
  "
  CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nd_data AS
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('data/processed/*.parquet')
  "
)

dataset_view <- tbl(duck_con, "nd_data")

```

Let's define a master raster file:

```{r}
sg_bounds <- st_read(
    here("data/shp/regionBound.geojson")
)

sg_utm <- sg_bounds |>
    st_transform(32648) |>
    st_make_valid()

sg_outline_utm <- st_union(sg_utm)

sg_vect <- terra::vect(sg_outline_utm)

pixel_locations <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    duck_con,
    "
    SELECT DISTINCT x, y
    FROM read_parquet('data/processed/*.parquet')
    "
)

hls_grid <- pixel_locations |>
    mutate(template = 1)

hls_template <- rast(
    hls_grid[, c("x", "y", "template")],
    type = "xyz",
    crs = "EPSG:32648"
)

hls_template <- mask(
    hls_template,
    sg_vect
)

template_output_path = "data/geotiff/template/hls_singapore_template.tif"

dir.create(dirname(here(template_output_path)), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

terra::writeRaster(
    hls_template,
    here(template_output_path),
    overwrite = TRUE
)
```
Create a function that will loop through number of years 2020-2026, and then loop through months 1 to 12 
use master raster at `template_output_path`

Directory:
`data/geotiff/ndvimi/individual_years/{year}/{month}`

Bands: 
1. NDVI
2. NDMI
3. Number of NDVI observations
4. Number of NDMI observations

```{r}
create_monthly_nd_rasters <- function(
    duck_con,
    template_output_path,
    years = 2020:2026,
    months = 1:12){
  template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)
  for (yr in years) {
    for (mo in months) {
      message("Processing ",yr, "-",sprintf("%02d", mo))
      query <- sprintf(
        "
        SELECT
            x,
            y,
            AVG(NDVI) AS NDVI,
            AVG(NDMI) AS NDMI,
            COUNT(NDVI) AS NDVI_nobs,
            COUNT(NDMI) AS NDMI_nobs
        FROM read_parquet('data/processed/*.parquet')
        WHERE
            year(date) = %d
            AND month(date) = %d
        GROUP BY
            x,
            y
        ",
        yr,
        mo
      )
      monthly_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(duck_con,query)
      if (nrow(monthly_df) == 0) {
        message("No data found. Skipping.")
        next
      }
      monthly_raster <- terra::rast(
        monthly_df[,c("x","y","NDVI","NDMI","NDVI_nobs","NDMI_nobs")],
        type = "xyz",
        crs = "EPSG:32648")

      names(monthly_raster) <- c("NDVI","NDMI","NDVI_nobs","NDMI_nobs")

      if (!terra::compareGeom(monthly_raster,template,stopOnError = FALSE)){
        monthly_raster <- terra::resample(monthly_raster,template,method = "near")}

      monthly_raster <- terra::mask(monthly_raster,template)
      
      output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","ndvimi","individual_years",as.character(yr))

      dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)

      output_file <- file.path(output_dir,sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif",yr,mo))

      terra::writeRaster(monthly_raster,output_file,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))

      message(output_file, " done.")

      rm(monthly_df,monthly_raster)
      gc()
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

Run the function:

```{r}
template_output_path = "data/geotiff/template/hls_singapore_template.tif"
create_monthly_nd_rasters(duck_con,template_output_path, year=2026:2026, months=1:9)
```
# Step 2: Save the average for 2020-2025 for each month (2020 to 2025 Sep) in a separate GeoTIFF layer
Directory: 
`data/geotiff/ndvimi/average/{month}`
Band 1 = mean monthly NDVI across available years
Band 2 = mean monthly NDMI across available years
Band 3 = number of years contributing NDVI
Band 4 = number of years contributing NDMI

```{r}
create_avg_monthly_nd_rasters <- function(
    template_output_path,
    individual_years_dir){
  template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)
  #  to get the average we need to loop through each month and find the list of files inside each year directory
  months = 1:12
  years_dirs <- list.dirs(path = individual_years_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  years <- as.integer(basename(years_dirs))
  for (month in months){
      if (month <= 9){
        years <- 2021:2025
    } else{
        years <- 2020:2024
    }
    # construct file name looping through the dir and find if that file exists
    # if file does not exist, continue
      message("Checking month ", month)
      tif_paths <- character()
      for(year in years){
          # check if this file exists
          check_file_path <- file.path(individual_years_dir, as.character(year), sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif",year,month))
          if (file.exists(check_file_path)){
              message(sprintf("File NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif exists",year,month))
              # add this to the list
              tif_paths <- c(tif_paths,check_file_path)
          } else{
              message(sprintf("File NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif does NOT exist",year,month))
          }
      }
      if (length(tif_paths) == 0) {
        message("No rasters available for month ",month)
        next
      }
    yearly_rasters <- lapply(tif_paths,terra::rast)
    geometry_ok <- vapply(yearly_rasters,function(r){terra::compareGeom(r,template,stopOnError = FALSE)},logical(1))
    if (!all(geometry_ok)) {
        stop("Raster geometry mismatch for month ",mo)
    }
    
    ndvi_stack <- terra::rast(lapply(yearly_rasters,function(r) r[["NDVI"]]))
    ndmi_stack <- terra::rast(lapply(yearly_rasters,function(r) r[["NDMI"]]))
    mean_ndvi <- terra::app(ndvi_stack,fun = mean,na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_ndmi <- terra::app(ndmi_stack,fun = mean,na.rm = TRUE)
    n_years_ndvi <- terra::app(ndvi_stack,fun = function(x){sum(!is.na(x))})
    n_years_ndmi <- terra::app(ndmi_stack,fun = function(x) {sum(!is.na(x))})
    historical_raster <- c(mean_ndvi,mean_ndmi,n_years_ndvi,n_years_ndmi)
    names(historical_raster) <- c("NDVI","NDMI","NDVI_nyears","NDMI_nyears")

    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","ndvimi","average")
    dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
    output_file <- file.path(output_dir,sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_average_%d.tif",month))
    terra::writeRaster(historical_raster,output_file,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))
    message(output_file, " done.")
    rm(yearly_rasters,ndvi_stack,ndmi_stack,mean_ndvi,mean_ndmi,n_years_ndvi,n_years_ndmi,historical_raster)
    gc()

}
invisible(NULL)
  }
  
```

Run the function now:

```{r}
template_output_path = "data/geotiff/template/hls_singapore_template.tif"
individual_years_dir = "data/geotiff/ndvimi/individual_years"
create_avg_monthly_nd_rasters(template_output_path,individual_years_dir)
```

# Step 3: NDVI and NDMI difference for 2026 and 2025 Oct - Dec

Directory: 
`data/geotiff/ndvimi/difference/{month}`

Simple: loop through 1:12. If month > 9, then check the 2025 dir otherwise keep to the 2026 dir. 
In each month loop, take the NDMI and NDVI average and the 2026/2025 rasters, subtract the bands.

```{r}
average_path <- "data/geotiff/ndvimi/average"
average_files <- list.files(average_path)
individual_path_base <- "data/geotiff/ndvimi/individual_years"

for (month in 1:12){
    if (month <= 9){
        current_year <- 2026
    } else{
        current_year <- 2025
    }
    individual_path <- file.path(individual_path_base, as.character(current_year))
    # get the correct average file
    average_file <- file.path(average_path, sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_average_%d.tif", month))
    current_file <- file.path(individual_path, sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif", current_year, month))
    average_raster <- terra::rast(average_file)
    current_raster <- terra::rast(current_file)
    average_file_ndvi <- average_raster[["NDVI"]]
    average_file_ndmi <- average_raster[["NDMI"]]
    current_file_ndvi <- current_raster[["NDVI"]]
    current_file_ndmi <- current_raster[["NDMI"]]
    
    ndmi_diff <- current_file_ndmi - average_file_ndmi
    ndvi_diff <- current_file_ndvi - average_file_ndvi
    ndvi_diff[average_raster[["NDVI_nyears"]] < 2] <- NA
    ndmi_diff[average_raster[["NDMI_nyears"]] < 2] <- NA
    diff_raster <- c(ndvi_diff, ndmi_diff)
    names(diff_raster) <- c("NDVI_diff", "NDMI_diff")
    
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","ndvimi","difference")
    dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
    output_file <- file.path(output_dir,sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_diff_%d.tif",month))
    terra::writeRaster(diff_raster,output_file,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))
    message(output_file, " done.")
    rm(average_raster, current_raster)
    gc()
}
```

# Step 4: Assign closest weather station data for precipitation and air temp 

Directory: 
`data/geotiff/weather/averaged/{month}`

## Precipitation

Load the precipitation dataset:

```{r}
file_paths <- list.files(path = here("data"), 
                         pattern = "rain202.*\\.csv$", 
                         full.names = TRUE)
precip_old_old <- read_csv(file_paths)
precip_old <- read_csv("data/sg_rainfall_historical.csv")
precip_new <- read_csv("data/precip2026_marchonwards.csv")
precip_df <- bind_rows(precip_old_old, precip_old, precip_new) |>
    select(-c("reading_update_timestamp", "reading_type")) |>
    mutate(station_id = as.factor(station_id)) |>
    filter(date > "2020-09-30")
```

QC of the precip data to see if stations report consistently
- group by date, lon and lat
- get total no. of readings
- sum is.na for each lon and lat and sum(!is.na)
- total readings should be 24 * (60/5) = 288 readings per station per day


```{r}
precip_coverage <- precip_df |>
    group_by(date, location_longitude,location_latitude)|>
    summarise(n_readings = n(),
              valid_readings = sum(!is.na(reading_value)),
              invalid_readings = sum(is.na(reading_value)))|>
    mutate(daily_reading_coverage = n_readings/288 *100,
           daily_valid_coverage = valid_readings / 288 * 100)

range(precip_coverage$daily_reading_coverage)
range(precip_coverage$daily_valid_coverage)

precip_coverage_bin <- precip_coverage |>
    mutate(bin_reading_coverage = cut(daily_reading_coverage, breaks = c(0, 50, 75, 90, 95, 100),
            include.lowest = TRUE),
           bin_valid_coverage = cut(daily_valid_coverage, breaks = c(0, 50, 75, 90, 95, 100),
            include.lowest = TRUE))

# ggplot(data=precip_coverage_bin, aes(x=bin_reading_coverage)) + geom_bar()
# ggplot(data=precip_coverage_bin, aes(x=bin_valid_coverage)) + geom_bar()

station_location_check <- precip_df |>
    filter(
        !is.na(station_id),
        !is.na(location_longitude),
        !is.na(location_latitude)
    ) |>
    distinct(
        station_id,
        location_longitude,
        location_latitude
    ) |>
    count(
        station_id,
        name = "n_locations"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(n_locations))

station_location_check |>
    filter(n_locations > 1)

```

For precip data, we want to get the monthly means of the following FOR EACH STATION:
- cumulative sum for the month in mm
- sum for the day and then mean daily sum rainfall for that month 

A rain day is a day that records 0.2mm day or more
```{r}
precip_df <- precip_df |>
    drop_na(location_longitude,location_latitude)

precip_daily <- precip_df |>
    filter(!is.na(station_id)) |>
    group_by(station_id,date,location_longitude, location_latitude)|>
    summarise(daily_sum = sum(reading_value, na.rm = TRUE),
              n_readings = sum(!is.na(reading_value)),
              .groups = "drop")

precip_monthly <- precip_daily |>
    group_by(station_id,location_longitude, location_latitude, year = lubridate::year(date),month = lubridate::month(date))|>
    summarise(mean_monthly_daily_sum = mean(daily_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
              cumulative_monthly = sum(daily_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
              valid_days = sum(n_readings > 0),
              rainy_days = sum(daily_sum >= 0.2 & n_readings > 0),
              .groups = "drop")

station_location <- precip_df |>
    filter(!is.na(station_id), !is.na(location_latitude), !is.na(location_longitude))|>
    group_by(station_id, location_longitude, location_latitude) |>
    summarise(first_date = min(date), last_date = max(date), .groups="drop")
    
```

Make a GeoTIFF file for every month with the following bands for those pixels:
- monthly mean daily sum 
- cumulative monthly 

First, create a permanent weather station look up raster:
1. extract the locations by removing NAs, getting unique coords and assigning station codes through row numbers
2. Turn it into spatial points with coordinates using sf
```{r}
template_output_path = "data/geotiff/template/hls_singapore_template.tif"
template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)

stations_sf <- st_as_sf(stations,
                      coords = c("location_longitude", "location_latitude"),
                      crs = 4326, remove=FALSE)

stations_utm <- st_transform(stations_sf, crs=terra::crs(template))

stations_vect <- terra::vect(stations_utm)
```

3. create voronoi polygon
4. rasterise onto the SG template grid

```{r}
station_voronoi <- terra::voronoi(stations_vect)

nearest_station <- terra::rasterize(station_voronoi, template, field="station_code")

nearest_station <- terra::mask(nearest_station, template)

names(nearest_station) <- "station_code"

terra::writeRaster(nearest_station, "data/geotiff/template/precip_stations.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
```

create the monthly precip rasters:

```{r}
create_monthly_precip_rasters <- function(
    precip_monthly,
    template_output_path,
    years = 2020:2026,
    months = 1:12,
    min_valid_days = 24){
  template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)
  bnd <- terra::as.polygons(terra::ext(template), crs=terra::crs(template))
  vars <- c("mean_monthly_daily_sum", "cumulative_monthly", "valid_days", "rainy_days")
  
  for (yr in years) {
      for (mo in months){
          message("Processing ", yr, " - ", mo)
          precip_month <- precip_monthly|>
              filter(year == yr, month == mo, valid_days >= min_valid_days)
          if (nrow(precip_month) == 0){
              message("No data for this month. Skipping.")
              next
          }
          pts <- terra::vect(precip_month, 
          geom = c("location_longitude", "location_latitude"),
          crs = "EPSG:4326") |>
            terra::project(terra::crs(template))
          month_voronoi <- terra::voronoi(pts, bnd = bnd)
          month_voronoi <- terra::crop(month_voronoi, bnd)
          
          layers <- lapply(vars, function(var){
            terra::rasterize(month_voronoi, template, field = var)
          })
          monthly_raster <- terra::mask(terra::rast(layers), template)
          names(monthly_raster) <- vars

          output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","climate_v2","precip","individual_years",as.character(yr))
          dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
          output_file <- file.path(output_dir,sprintf("precip_station_monthly_%d_%02d.tif",yr,mo))
          terra::writeRaster(monthly_raster,output_file,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))
          message(output_file, " done.")
          rm(monthly_raster, layers, month_voronoi, pts)
          gc()
      }
  }
    invisible(NULL)
}
```

call the function:

## Temperature

Load the temp dataset:

```{r}
file_paths <- list.files(path = here("data"), 
                         pattern = "temp202.*\\.csv$", 
                         full.names = TRUE)

temp_df <- read_csv(file_paths, id = "file_source") |>
    select(-c("update_timestamp", "station_device_id", "reading_update_timestamp", "reading_type", "reading_unit"))|>
    mutate(station_id = as.factor(station_id)) |>
    filter(date > "2020-09-30") |>
    drop_na()

```

The reading is taken every 1 minute. 

There are 38 station IDs and 67 station names, some of which are called by their station id names. Let's just categorize by lon and lat again to make things easier.

Interesting data to derive from this is the mean monthly daily mean, mean monthly daily max, mean monthly daily low and max daily max and min daily min so let's do that:

```{r}
daily_temp_df <- temp_df |>
    group_by(station_name, location_longitude, location_latitude, year = lubridate::year(date), month = lubridate::month(date), day = lubridate::day(date)) |>
    summarise(
        daily_max = max(reading_value),
        daily_min = min(reading_value),
        daily_mean = mean(reading_value),
        n_readings = sum(!is.na(reading_value)),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

monthly_temp_df <- daily_temp_df |>
    group_by(station_name, location_longitude, location_latitude, year, month) |>
    summarise(
        mean_monthly_mean = mean(daily_mean),
        mean_monthly_max = mean(daily_max),
        mean_monthly_min = mean(daily_min),
        max_monthly_max = max(daily_max),
        min_monthly_min = min(daily_min),
        valid_days = sum(n_readings > 0),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

```

Let's make the function that will create the voronoi for the temp data:

```{r}
create_monthly_temp_rasters <- function(
    monthly_temp_df,
    template_output_path,
    years = 2020:2026,
    months = 1:12,
    min_valid_days = 24){
  template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)
  bnd <- terra::as.polygons(terra::ext(template), crs=terra::crs(template))
  vars <- c("mean_monthly_mean", "mean_monthly_max", "mean_monthly_min", "max_monthly_max", "min_monthly_min", "valid_days")
  
  for (yr in years) {
      for (mo in months){
          message("Processing ", yr, " - ", mo)
          temp_month <- monthly_temp_df|>
              filter(year == yr, month == mo, valid_days >= min_valid_days)
          if (nrow(temp_month) == 0){
              message("No data for this month. Skipping.")
              next
          }
          pts <- terra::vect(temp_month, 
          geom = c("location_longitude", "location_latitude"),
          crs = "EPSG:4326") |>
            terra::project(terra::crs(template))
          month_voronoi <- terra::voronoi(pts, bnd = bnd)
          month_voronoi <- terra::crop(month_voronoi, bnd)
          
          layers <- lapply(vars, function(var){
            terra::rasterize(month_voronoi, template, field = var)
          })
          monthly_raster <- terra::mask(terra::rast(layers), template)
          names(monthly_raster) <- vars

          output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","climate_v2","temp","individual_years",as.character(yr))
          dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
          output_file <- file.path(output_dir,sprintf("temp_station_monthly_%d_%02d.tif",yr,mo))
          terra::writeRaster(monthly_raster,output_file,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))
          message(output_file, " done.")
          rm(monthly_raster, layers, month_voronoi, pts)
          gc()
      }
  }
    invisible(NULL)
}
```

and call the function:

```{r}
template_output_path = "data/geotiff/template/hls_singapore_template.tif"
create_monthly_temp_rasters(monthly_temp_df, template_output_path, min_valid_days = 0)
```

# Step 5: precip and airtemp difference for 2026 and 2025 Oct - Dec

Let's make a function that takes the following arguments:
- temp or precip directory
- min year (2020) and max years (2025)
- calculate the max month-year from the min year (ie october 2025)
- year of interest (2026)

and then open the list of raster of files, we can find the month because of the file name. take the mean.

separately open 2026 of that month and then just take the difference.

save as a separate raster file. 

```
file_paths <- list.files(
  path = "path/to/parent_directory", 
  pattern = "\\_07.tif$", 
  full.names = TRUE, 
  recursive = TRUE
)
```

making some helper functions first, namely to find min month and to find max month
```{r}
months_range <- function(min_year_dir){
    min_year_months_paths <- list.files(min_year_dir)
    month_strings <- str_sub(min_year_months_paths, -6, -5)
    months_vector <- as.double(month_strings)
    min(months_vector, na.rm=TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
create_diff_raster<- function(parent_dir, min_year = 2020, number_of_mean_years = 5, year_of_interest = 2026, drop_layers = c("valid_days", "rainy_days")){
    file_paths <- list.files(
        path = parent_dir,
        # only the monthly station rasters, so earlier mean_difference outputs are never read back in
        pattern = "_station_monthly_\\d{4}_\\d{2}\\.tif$",
        full.names = TRUE,
        recursive = TRUE
    )
    year_month <- str_match(file_paths, "_(\\d{4})_(\\d{2})\\.tif$")
    file_info <- tibble(
        path = file_paths,
        year = as.integer(year_month[, 2]),
        month = as.integer(year_month[, 3]),
        date = lubridate::make_date(year, month, 1)
    )
    min_month <- months_range(file.path(parent_dir, min_year))
    window_start <- lubridate::make_date(min_year, min_month, 1)
    window_end <- window_start + lubridate::years(number_of_mean_years)
    baseline_files <- file_info |>
        filter(date >= window_start, date < window_end)
    monthly_means <- lapply(1:12, function(m) {
        month_paths <- baseline_files |> filter(month == m) |> pull(path)
        month_stack <- terra::rast(month_paths)
        month_stack <- month_stack[[!names(month_stack) %in% drop_layers]]
        terra::tapp(month_stack, index = names(month_stack), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    names(monthly_means) <- sprintf("%02d", 1:12)
    
    current_files <- file_info |>
        filter(date >= window_end)

    output_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "mean_difference")
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(current_files))) {
        yr <- current_files$year[i]
        mo <- current_files$month[i]
        current_rast <- terra::rast(current_files$path[i])
        current_rast <- current_rast[[!names(current_rast) %in% drop_layers]]
        diff_rast <- current_rast - monthly_means[[sprintf("%02d", mo)]]

        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("mean_difference_%d_%02d.tif", yr, mo))
        terra::writeRaster(diff_rast, output_file, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE", "TILED=YES")))
        message(output_file, " done.")
    }
    invisible(NULL)
}
```

Call the function:

```{r}
precip_path <- "data/geotiff/climate_v2/precip/individual_years"
temp_path <- "data/geotiff/climate_v2/temp/individual_years"

for(p in c(precip_path, temp_path)){
    print(p)
    create_diff_raster((p))
}

create_diff_raster(temp_path)
```

# Step 6: Land use layer 

Loading the URA masterplan 2025 LU:

I want to mask out water bodies, let's pull out waterbody from the `lu`

```{r}
waterbody <- lu[lu$LU_DESC == "WATERBODY",]
```

masking out water bodies:

```{r}
output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","ndvimi","difference_watermasked")
dir.create(output_dir,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)

# load the diff rasters
waterbody_transformed <- st_transform(waterbody, crs ="EPSG:32648")
waterbody_vect <- terra::vect(waterbody_transformed)
diff_path <- "data/geotiff/ndvimi/difference"
diff_files <- list.files(diff_path)

# loop through each diff_raster
for (d in diff_files){
    # mask out water bodies 
    diff_raster <- terra::rast(file.path(diff_path,d))
    watermasked_raster <- terra::mask(diff_raster,waterbody_vect,inverse = TRUE)
    file_name <- str_sub(d, end = -5)
    file_path <- paste0(output_dir, "/", file_name, "_watermasked.tif")
    terra::writeRaster(watermasked_raster,filename=file_path,overwrite = TRUE,wopt = list(gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE","TILED=YES")))
    message(file_path, " written")
    rm(diff_raster, watermasked_raster)
    gc()
}

```

# Penultimate step: Distill into csv file if needed

One csv per comparison month (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026). Each row is a land pixel of the template, and each column is a layer:
- `precip_*`, `temp_*`: station values for that month
- `precip_diff_*`, `temp_diff_*`: difference from the 5-year mean
- `NDVI`, `NDMI`: HLS values for that month (water-masked)
- `NDVI_diff`, `NDMI_diff`: difference from the 5-year mean (water-masked)

If a source has no file for a month (e.g. temp for Oct 2025), its columns are left as NA so every csv has the same columns.

```{r}
read_prefixed <- function(path, prefix, keep_layers, template){
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        r <- terra::rast(template, nlyrs = length(keep_layers), vals = NA)
        names(r) <- keep_layers
    } else {
        r <- terra::rast(path)[[keep_layers]]
    }
    names(r) <- paste0(prefix, names(r))
    r
}

create_monthly_csvs <- function(
    template_output_path,
    output_dir = here("data", "csv"),
    first_month = as.Date("2025-10-01"),
    n_months = 12,
    drop_layers = c("valid_days", "rainy_days"),
    lu_path = here("data", "shp", "LU.geojson")){
  template <- terra::rast(template_output_path)
  waterbody_vect <- read_sf(lu_path) |>
      filter(LU_DESC == "WATERBODY") |>
      st_transform(crs = terra::crs(template)) |>
      terra::vect()
  climate_base <- here("data", "geotiff", "climate_v2")
  ndvimi_base <- here("data", "geotiff", "ndvimi")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # layer names to keep from each climate source, taken from any existing file
  climate_layers <- lapply(c(precip = "precip", temp = "temp"), function(v){
      ref_file <- list.files(file.path(climate_base, v, "individual_years"),
                             pattern = "_station_monthly_\\d{4}_\\d{2}\\.tif$",
                             full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]
      setdiff(names(terra::rast(ref_file)), drop_layers)
  })

  for (i in seq_len(n_months)) {
      month_date <- seq(first_month, by = "month", length.out = n_months)[i]
      yr <- lubridate::year(month_date)
      mo <- lubridate::month(month_date)
      message("Processing ", yr, " - ", mo)

      layers <- list()
      for (v in c("precip", "temp")) {
          years_dir <- file.path(climate_base, v, "individual_years")
          layers[[v]] <- read_prefixed(
              file.path(years_dir, yr, sprintf("%s_station_monthly_%d_%02d.tif", v, yr, mo)),
              paste0(v, "_"), climate_layers[[v]], template)
          layers[[paste0(v, "_diff")]] <- read_prefixed(
              file.path(years_dir, "mean_difference", sprintf("mean_difference_%d_%02d.tif", yr, mo)),
              paste0(v, "_diff_"), climate_layers[[v]], template)
      }
      layers$ndvimi <- read_prefixed(
          file.path(ndvimi_base, "individual_years", yr, sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_%d_%02d.tif", yr, mo)),
          "", c("NDVI", "NDMI"), template) |>
          terra::mask(waterbody_vect, inverse = TRUE)
      layers$ndvimi_diff <- read_prefixed(
          file.path(ndvimi_base, "difference_watermasked", sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_diff_%d_watermasked.tif", mo)),
          "", c("NDVI_diff", "NDMI_diff"), template)

      month_stack <- terra::mask(terra::rast(unname(layers)), template)
      # na.rm = NA drops only cells where every layer is NA, i.e. outside the template
      month_df <- terra::as.data.frame(month_stack, xy = TRUE, na.rm = NA)
      lonlat <- terra::project(as.matrix(month_df[, c("x", "y")]), from = terra::crs(template), to = "EPSG:4326")

      month_df <- month_df |>
          mutate(across(-c(x, y), \(v) round(v, 4))) |>
          mutate(lon = round(lonlat[, 1], 6), lat = round(lonlat[, 2], 6), year = yr, month = mo, .after = y)

      output_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("pixels_%d_%02d.csv", yr, mo))
      readr::write_csv(month_df, output_file, na = "")
      message(output_file, " done.")
      rm(layers, month_stack, month_df, lonlat)
      gc()
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

and call the function:

```{r}
create_monthly_csvs(template_output_path)
```
